Plot Lorentz Coordinates in the Poincare Disk

Source: R/plot.R
plot_lhwr_poincare_map.Rd

Visualize Lorentz hyperboloid coordinates in the Poincare disk. This is a display tool: distances and model estimation in LHWR are still based on the original Lorentz-hyperbolic geometry unless the user explicitly uses another geometry. The function is useful for network, similarity, and trade-map applications where nodes, edge backbones, labels, node sizes, and value-based colors should be shown in a hyperbolic disk view.

Usage

plot_lhwr_poincare_map(
  Z,
  values = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  significant = NULL,
  significance_adjusted = NULL,
  significance_direction = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  node_names = NULL,
  sizes = NULL,
  edges = NULL,
  edge_weight = NULL,
  edge_alpha_range = c(0.08, 0.3),
  edge_lwd_range = c(0.25, 1.6),
  node_id = NULL,
  title = "LHWR Poincare disk map",
  value_label = "Value",
  group_label = "groups",
  size_label = "Node size",
  edge_label = "Edges",
  disk_radius = 0.94,
  radial_rescale = TRUE,
  radial_quantile = 1,
  radial_power = 1,
  show_all_labels = TRUE,
  n_label = 30L,
  label_cex = NULL,
  degree_cex = NULL,
  legend_cex = NULL,
  colorbar_cex = NULL,
  title_cex = NULL,
  info_cex = NULL,
  point_min = NULL,
  point_max = NULL,
  plot_control = NULL,
  point_palette = "Blue-Red 3",
  group_palette = NULL,
  significance_colors = c(`Not significant` = "#BDBDBD", Significant = "#2E7D32"),
  signed_significance_colors = c(`Not significant` = "#C9C9C9", `Negative significant` =
    "#7B3294", `Positive significant` = "#2E7D32"),
  adjusted_significance_colors = c(`Not significant` = "#C9C9C9", `Raw only` = "#E69F00",
    `Raw and BH` = "#1B7837"),
  significance_label = "Local significance",
  background_col = "#F6F1E7",
  boundary_col = "#0A9396",
  edge_col = "#607D8B",
  show_colorbar = TRUE,
  show_group_legend = TRUE,
  group_legend_position = c("right", "bottom"),
  show_size_legend = TRUE,
  show_info = TRUE,
  output_file = NULL,
  width = 1500,
  height = 1500,
  res = 170,
  ...
)

Arguments

Z

An n x 3 Lorentz hyperboloid coordinate matrix with columns (z0, z1, z2).

values

Optional numeric vector used to color points. If omitted and groups is also omitted, points use a single color.

groups

Optional grouping variable used for categorical point colors. Ignored when values or significant is supplied.

significant

Optional logical vector. If supplied, points are colored as significant/non-significant using significance_colors; useful for local p-value maps.

significance_adjusted

Optional logical vector used together with significant. If supplied, local significance is classified as not significant, raw-only significant, or significant after adjustment. This is useful for comparing raw local p-values with multiplicity-adjusted p-values without drawing a second map.

significance_direction

Optional numeric vector used together with significant. Negative values are shown as negative significant, positive values as positive significant, and non-significant locations remain grey. This is useful for local coefficient maps where both significance and sign should be visible.

labels

Optional labels for points, for example country ISO3 codes.

node_names

Optional longer node names used in map summaries.

sizes

Optional nonnegative numeric vector for point sizes. A common choice is original total trade or a node degree/strength measure. The map already applies log1p before rescaling sizes; do not log-transform twice unless that additional visual transformation is explicitly intended.

edges

Optional edge list as a data frame or matrix with two columns. Entries may be integer row indices or labels matching node_id.

edge_weight

Optional numeric vector of edge weights used for line widths and transparency.

edge_alpha_range

Length-2 numeric vector giving the minimum and maximum edge transparency. Larger values make network links more visible.

edge_lwd_range

Length-2 numeric vector giving the minimum and maximum edge line width.

node_id

Optional node identifiers used to match edges when edge endpoints are not integer row indices.

title

Plot title. Use NULL to suppress the title, which is useful when the title is supplied in a manuscript caption.

value_label

Label for the colorbar when values is supplied.

group_label

Label used in summaries and captions when groups is supplied.

size_label

Label explaining point size.

edge_label

Label explaining edges.

disk_radius

Visual radius used by the largest point after optional radial scaling. This changes only the display, not Z or distances.

radial_rescale

If TRUE, rescales Poincare coordinates for display. This changes only the graphic, not Z or the distances used by LHWR.

radial_quantile

Quantile of the Poincare radii used as the visual reference radius when radial_rescale = TRUE. The default 1 preserves the previous behavior. Values below 1 are useful when a few peripheral points would otherwise compress the rest of the map.

radial_power

Positive power applied to rescaled radii for display. Values below 1 spread central points outward while preserving angles.

show_all_labels

If TRUE, all labels are drawn. If FALSE, only the largest n_label points according to sizes are labeled.

n_label

Number of labels to draw when show_all_labels = FALSE.

label_cex

Label size. If NULL, the value in plot_control is used.

degree_cex

Character size for degree labels on the disk boundary.

legend_cex

Character size for categorical, significance, and size legends.

colorbar_cex

Character size for numeric colorbar labels and title.

title_cex

Character size for the plot title.

info_cex

Character size for the optional information box.

point_min, point_max

Minimum and maximum point sizes after scaling.

plot_control

Optional list created by lhwr_plot_control(). Direct arguments such as label_cex or legend_cex override values in this list.

point_palette

HCL palette for numeric values.

group_palette

Optional vector of colors for groups.

significance_colors

Named or unnamed length-2 color vector for significant = FALSE and significant = TRUE, respectively.

signed_significance_colors

Named or unnamed length-3 color vector for not significant, negative significant, and positive significant locations when both significant and significance_direction are supplied.

adjusted_significance_colors

Named or unnamed length-3 color vector for not significant, raw-only significant, and raw-and-adjusted significant locations when both significant and significance_adjusted are supplied.

significance_label

Legend title used when significant is supplied.

background_col

Disk background color.

boundary_col

Disk boundary color.

edge_col

Edge color.

show_colorbar

Logical; draw a colorbar for numeric values.

show_group_legend

Logical; draw a legend for categorical groups.

group_legend_position

Position for the categorical/significance legend. Use "right" for a side legend or "bottom" to keep the legend below the disk when side placement overlaps the plot.

show_size_legend

Logical; draw point-size legend.

show_info

Logical; draw an explanatory annotation box.

output_file

Optional output path. PDF and EPS/PS extensions select the corresponding device; other extensions use PNG. Existing files may be overwritten: check the target first if preservation is required.

width, height, res

Width and height in pixels and resolution in pixels per inch. PDF/EPS dimensions in inches are width/res and height/res. These differ from the inch-based hyperboloid output settings.

...

Additional graphical arguments currently ignored.

Value

Invisibly returns a data frame containing the Poincare coordinates used for plotting.

Examples

set.seed(1)
H <- simulate_H2(40, r_max = 3)
Z <- H$Z
plot_lhwr_poincare_map(
  Z,
  values = H$r,
  labels = paste0("n", seq_len(nrow(Z))),
  title = "Simulated points in the Poincare disk",
  value_label = "radius"
)
